title: Broccoli and Chicken Stir Fry
description: Chicken and broccoli in a quick honey-soy sauce with fresh garlic and ginger, thickened glossy with a cornstarch slurry. Serve over rice.

imageCredit.author: Discover Lehigh Valley, PA
imageCredit.title: Chicken And Broccoli @ Bamboo Asian Cuisine

steps.heading: Cook the Broccoli
steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp of the oil in a skillet. Once hot, add the broccoli and cook until soft, about 5 minutes (add 2 tbsp water while it cooks if you like it softer). Move to a plate.

steps.heading: Cook the Chicken
steps.text: Add the remaining 2 tbsp oil and the chicken to the skillet, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and cook until the chicken reaches 165°F.

steps.heading: Mix the Sauce
steps.text: In a small bowl, whisk the soy sauce and honey with ¼ cup water. Separately, mix the cornstarch with 2 tbsp water.

steps.heading: Bring It Together
steps.text: Add the ginger and garlic to the chicken and stir until fragrant. Return the broccoli, pour in the sauce and the slurry, and stir until thickened. Serve over rice.
